get_blocked_servers.description: Get Mojang's list of blocked server hashes. Each entry is the SHA-1 hash of a blocked server hostname.
get_blocked_servers.name: get_blocked_servers

get_player_textures.description: Get a player's skin and cape as ready-to-use image URLs, decoded from their profile: the skin URL and model (classic or slim), and the cape URL if they have one.
get_player_textures.display_str_template: Get the Minecraft skin & cape for UUID {0}.
get_player_textures.name: get_player_textures

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft UUID, for example 853c80ef3c3749fdaa49938b674adae6. Look one up with 'Get UUID by username'.
parameters.name: uuid

get_profile.description: Get a player's profile by UUID, including the base64-encoded textures property (skin and cape). Optionally include Mojang's signature over the textures data.
get_profile.display_str_template: Get the Minecraft profile for UUID {0}.
get_profile.name: get_profile

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft UUID, for example 853c80ef3c3749fdaa49938b674adae6. Look one up with 'Get UUID by username'.
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.description: Also return Mojang's signature over the textures data. Leave off unless you need to verify the data's authenticity.
parameters.name: include_signature

get_public_keys.description: Get Mojang's public keys, used to verify signed profile properties, player chat certificates, and authentication data.
get_public_keys.name: get_public_keys

get_username_by_uuid.description: Look up a Minecraft player's current username from their UUID (dashed or undashed).
get_username_by_uuid.display_str_template: Get the Minecraft username for UUID {0}.
get_username_by_uuid.name: get_username_by_uuid

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft UUID, for example 853c80ef3c3749fdaa49938b674adae6. Dashed or undashed are both accepted.
parameters.name: uuid

get_uuid_by_username.description: Look up a Minecraft player's UUID (and canonical name casing) from their username.
get_uuid_by_username.display_str_template: Get the Minecraft UUID for username {0}.
get_uuid_by_username.name: get_uuid_by_username

parameters.description: The player's Minecraft username, for example jeb_. Case-insensitive; the response returns the canonical casing.
parameters.name: username

get_uuids_by_usernames.description: Resolve up to 10 Minecraft usernames to their UUIDs in one request. Usernames that don't exist are omitted from the result.
get_uuids_by_usernames.display_str_template: Get Minecraft UUIDs for a list of usernames.
get_uuids_by_usernames.name: get_uuids_by_usernames

parameters.description: The Minecraft usernames to resolve (up to 10 per request).
parameters.name: usernames

description: Look up Minecraft players and public game data through Mojang's official public API: resolve usernames to UUIDs (and back), bulk-resolve up to 10 usernames at once, fetch a player's profile with skin and cape textures, list Mojang's blocked servers, and read Mojang's signing public keys. No account or API key required.
